Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.shape

Class VoxelGrid

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.shape.VoxelGrid
public final class VoxelGrid extends Object
A voxel shape as Bedrock keeps and sends it: per axis the sorted coordinates of a grid (in blocks), and which of the cells between them are filled. Immutable, with value equality: BDS keeps one shape per distinct grid.

Every rule here is what BDS does, read from captures (docs/wire-notes.md, "Voxel shapes") and checked by the conformance test of the tools against every captured build:

  • a grid is minimal: no coordinate with the same cells on both sides, none outside the filled cells;
  • the cell at (x, y, z) is bit (x * ySize + y) * zSize + z of the storage, the least significant bit of a byte first;
  • the empty shape has no cells and the coordinate 0 on every axis.
